rules.evidence: FAA states that recently submitted SDRs are unavailable to the public until FAA approval and Quality Control review is complete.
rules.rule: Never copy SubmissionDate into available_at. A separate approval/publication artifact is required.

rules.evidence: DifficultyDate identifies when the service difficulty occurred; FAA public availability happens only after submission and approval/QC.

rules.field: current annual CSV row and fields
rules.evidence: FAA currently publishes yearly SDR CSV downloads, but current presence does not establish when the row or its present field values first became public.
rules.rule: Treat current CSV presence as current-source evidence only. Historical cutoff admission requires an archived release or record-specific publication evidence.

default_rule.rule: Without explicit approval/publication timing or an immutable archived public snapshot, historical SDR field/value availability remains unknown and is excluded from strict PIT backtests.
